prompts.name: ПРОТОКОЛ
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original faction emblem for a pixel-art modern-world strategy game, one square game-ready PNG, genuinely transparent background. Style: premium tactical pixel art, deliberately stepped hard pixel edges and bold readable silhouette, limited palette, strong negative space, cohesive military-science-fiction heraldic language, crisp front view, very restrained material shading. Centered single emblem occupying about 75% of canvas, generous transparent padding. Must remain recognizable at 48 pixels. No text, no letters, no typography, no watermark, no scenery, no enclosing rectangle, no mockup. It is a symbolic logo, not a detailed environmental illustration. Faction ПРОТОКОЛ / THE PROTOCOL: autonomous drones, AI and robotic geodetic platforms. Logo: a heavy geometric ground-drill/tech anchor as central vertical mark, split mechanical arms and three tiny sensor-drone satellite nodes connected by precise circuit traces, suggesting grounded energy extraction and a coordinated network. Steel-black and luminous electric cyan with small pale highlights. Disciplined, symmetric, machine intelligence.
